hebrewText: וְ/אִם יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּ/לְקַחְתִּ֑י/ם וְ/אִם יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִ/נֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַ/י֙ בְּ/קַרְקַ֣ע הַ/יָּ֔ם מִ/שָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת הַ/נָּחָ֖שׁ וּ/נְשָׁכָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)

tokens.bdb: Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine
there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: to seek; causatively, to conceal oneself (i.e. let be sought), or mask
tokens.kjv: change, (make) diligent (search), disquise self, hide, search (for, out).

tokens.bdb: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: accept, bring, buy, carry away, drawn, fetch, get, infold, [idiom] many, mingle, place, receive(-ing), reserve, seize, send for, take (away, -ing, up), use, win.
